page_title: AUG 0-1 LEV | Augsburg v Bayer Leverkusen 13/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' 0 - 1 Fantastic team goal! Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) was set free in the area by Alejandro Grimaldo and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the right side of the net. 0:1.
90+2' Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Sven Jablonski blows his whistle for an infringement.
90+1' Bayer Leverkusen are ruled offside.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) is adjudged offside.
89' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

89' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) meets a delivery on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the left side of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and the keeper pulls off an easy save. The linesman makes the right call and Bayer Leverkusen will have a corner.
88' Substitution. Elvis Rexhbecaj will be replaced by Robert Gumny (Augsburg).
87' Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
84' Bayer Leverkusen take a short corner kick.
83' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bayer Leverkusen comes to nothing.
82' Golden chance! Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post.
80' The substitution is prepared. Sven Michel (Augsburg) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Phillip Tietz.
80' Jess Thorup has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Dion Beljo (Augsburg) replacing Ermedin Demirovic.
80' That's the end of the game for Fredrik Jensen, who is replaced by Arne Engels (Augsburg).
76' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
75' The goal by Augsburg is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
73' Attention! Referee Sven Jablonski straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
72' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
71' Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) commits a foul and Sven Jablonski immediately signals a free kick.
69' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post.
68' End of season bloopers alert! Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) brilliantly side steps Lukas Hradecky but misses an open goal.
66' Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) sends an accurate short pass. Florian Wirtz controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
66' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post.
64' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
63' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 2:15.
62' Jess Thorup has decided to make a change. Arne Maier (Augsburg) replaces Ruben Vargas.
62' The referee signals a substitution. Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) is brought on as a substitute for Adam Hlozek.
59' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) comes close to scoring! He meets a lovely lofted pass from Jonas Hofmann, but sends his close-range header way wide of the left post.
58' An attempted cross from Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) is cleared.
57' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
55' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the left post.
54' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) prepares to take a corner kick.
53' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
51' Granit Xhaka releases Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) with a pass, he composes himself and shoots from mid-range but the ball curls well wide of the right post.
50' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
49' Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.
48' Close! Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Niklas Dorsch (Augsburg) was quite harsh and Sven Jablonski didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
43' Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up a wayward pass but gives away possession by shooting from distance. The ball went miles wide of the right post.
42' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
42' Adam Hlozek (Bayer Leverkusen) meets a cross inside the box, but his header is blocked by an opposing player.
41' The Augsburg players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
40' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
40' Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Finn Dahmen intercepts the ball.

37' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the left post, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop the effort.
36' There's an opportunity for Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

36' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bayer Leverkusen will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
36' A cross from Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.

34' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Finn Dahmen, who pulls off a comfortable save!
34' A player from Augsburg pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle.
33' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post.
32' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
31' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
30' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Bayer Leverkusen was in an offside position.
28' Crossbar! Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up a precise pass and produces a bullet of a strike from distance that smashes against the crossbar. It could have been a brilliant goal.
27' The foul by Adam Hlozek (Bayer Leverkusen) was seen by Sven Jablonski who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
25' A crossfield pass from Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to find any of his teammates.
24' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
22' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) latches on to a precise cross and hammers the ball goalwards, but it flies just wide of the right post.
21' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner.

20' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked. The ball is out of play. Bayer Leverkusen win a corner kick.
19' The referee gives a yellow card to Iago (Augsburg) for talking back. He must be careful for the remainder of the match.
18' That's a clear yellow card. Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) goes into the book.
18' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) latches on to an accurate pass into the box and immediately unleashes a low shot goalwards. His effort is well saved by the keeper.
17' Good defending. Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to find Adam Hlozek inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
15' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
14' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked.
14' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
13' The referee awards a corner and Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) goes over to take it.
13' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Lukas Hradecky scrambling, but it flies just wide of the right post.
11' Iago (Augsburg) makes a strong challenge and Sven Jablonski blows for a foul.
9' Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.

9' Bayer Leverkusen are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
7' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) passes the ball onto Jeremie Frimpong, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
6' Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
5' Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) shows his incredible technical ability by sending the ball into free space and Alejandro Grimaldo latches onto his pass.
4' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
3' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. It will be a corner kick for Bayer Leverkusen.
2' Sven Jablonski blows the whistle, Niklas Dorsch (Augsburg) is penalised for a foul.
2' The Augsburg players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a yellow card for infringement.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Augsburg will kick-off.
Sven Jablonski will officiate today.
